item.title: Claude Helped a Hacker Find a Way to Issue Tickets to Almost Every US Music Festival
item.description: A researcher found that using Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.7, he could break into the website of Front Gate—used by every festival from Lollapalooza to Bonnaroo—and freely issue any ticket he chose.

item.title: The Trump Administration Is Lifting Its Export Controls on Anthropic’s Mythos and Fable AI Models
item.description: The White House is easing restrictions on Anthropic’s most advanced AI models weeks after ordering the company to suspend access for foreign nationals.

item.title: Bernie Sanders Saw This Coming
item.description: For decades, the senator has argued that concentrated wealth threatened American democracy. Now he’s betting that frustration with Big Tech, billionaires, and unchecked AI is reaching a tipping point.

item.title: Meta Contractors Posed as Teens to Prompt Rival Chatbots About Suicide, Sex, and Drugs
item.description: Hundreds of contractors working on a project for Meta pretended to be kids in order to see how other chatbots like Gemini and ChatGPT would respond to high-risk subjects, WIRED found.

item.title: This Humanoid Robot Is a Terrifyingly Competent Office Intern
item.description: Flexion Robotics, a startup founded by ex-Nvidia engineers, has a clever way of training robots to do useful work.

item.title: Trump Administration Allows Anthropic to Release Mythos to Select US Organizations
item.description: After weeks of negotiations, the White House permitted Anthropic to grant access to its most advanced AI model to a select group of US companies and government agencies.

item.title: OpenAI Has New AI Models. Here’s Why You Can’t Use Them
item.description: The White House asked OpenAI to delay the rollout of its GPT-5.6 AI models, two weeks after Anthropic had to take its most advanced AI models offline.

item.title: Europe Is Fed Up and Wants Its Own AI
item.description: It's a stretch to think that the continent can build a top-tier model, but it has an advantage: Donald Trump.

item.title: How Qatar Became FIFA’s Technology Test Lab
item.description: Qatar has become the place where FIFA experiments with the next generation of football technology. The results are already visible across this year’s World Cup.

item.title: Anthropic Thinks Its Own Success Is Key to Making AI Safe
item.description: Anthropic's critics argue it's rapidly accumulating power. The company says that's what responsible AI development looks like.
